response.text: {"verdict": "covered", "clause_ids": ["A7.1", "A13.2"], "rationale": "The claim involves the theft of a winter coat from a parked car in Rimini, which was reported to the police. Clause A7.1 covers theft of luggage, and the police report (A13.2) confirms the theft. Clause A7.5 does not apply because the theft occurred in a vehicle, but the police report indicates the item was stolen, not left unattended. General exclusions (A11) do not apply as there is no indication of intentional action, alcohol, extreme sports, or war/terrorism."}
